name: Task format
desc:
How task properties are written in your notes.

Tasks reads one format at a time: with Dataview selected, emoji properties are ignored.

Reload Obsidian to apply this change.

See the documentation

name: Global filter
desc:
Only checklist items containing this text are tasks. Leave empty to treat every checklist item as a task.

For example, with #task, other checklist items are ignored by Tasks.

See the documentation

name: Hide global filter
desc:
Hide the global filter text when displaying tasks.

Reload Obsidian to apply this change.

name: Task statuses
desc:
Core statuses work with any theme.

For custom statuses, first install a theme or CSS snippet that styles them, then add matching statuses here.

Reload Obsidian to apply this change.

See the documentation
Built-in statuses that work with any theme. You can rename them and change what they toggle to.
Each symbol can only be used once. Later duplicates are ignored.

name: Import from theme
desc: Add the statuses supported by a theme or CSS snippet.

name: Add statuses found in vault
desc: Add any status symbols used in your notes that are not set up yet.

name: Create status report
desc: Create a note that lists your statuses, with a diagram of how they toggle.

name: Reset custom statuses
desc: Replace all custom statuses with the defaults.

name: Global query
desc:
Instructions added to the start of every query.

See the documentation

name: Allow JavaScript in queries
desc:
Enables filter by function, sort by function and group by function. Applies to this device only.

See the documentation

name: Presets
desc:
Reusable query snippets. Use preset name or {{preset.name}} in any query.

See the documentation

name: Add created date
desc:
Add today's date as the created date to tasks made with 'Create or edit task', and to the next occurrence of recurring tasks.

See the documentation

name: Add done date
desc:
Add the completion date when a task is marked done.

See the documentation

name: Add cancelled date
desc:
Add the date when a task is cancelled.

See the documentation

name: Use file name as scheduled date
desc:
Tasks with no start, scheduled or due date get a scheduled date from their file name, such as YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD.

Reload Obsidian to apply this change.

See the documentation

name: Extra date format
desc:
Another date format to recognise in file names, using Moment.js syntax.

Reload Obsidian to apply this change.

See the documentation

name: Only in folders
desc:
Comma-separated list of folders. Leave empty to use all folders.

Reload Obsidian to apply this change.

name: Next occurrence goes below
desc:
Insert the next occurrence below the completed task, instead of above it.

See the documentation

name: Drop scheduled date on recurrence
desc:
If a recurring task has a start or due date, its next occurrence gets no scheduled date.

See the documentation

name: Auto-suggest
desc:
Suggest dates, priorities and other properties while you type a task.

Reload Obsidian to apply this change.

See the documentation

name: Minimum characters
desc:
Characters to type before suggestions appear. 0 shows them straight away.

Reload Obsidian to apply this change.

name: Maximum suggestions
desc:
The most suggestions to show at once.

Reload Obsidian to apply this change.

name: Property style
desc: How task properties such as dates and priority are shown in results, dialogs and menus. Your notes are not changed.

name: Render properties in Live Preview
desc: Show task properties compactly in Live Preview, in the chosen property style. Put the cursor on a property to see and edit its text.

name: Task count position
desc: Where query results show the number of tasks.

name: Dialog keyboard shortcuts
desc:
Turn off if the keyboard shortcuts in Tasks dialogs clash with other shortcuts or assistive technology.

See the documentation
